script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Downloads-20261102-Chrome'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $d){throw 'Download directory already exists'}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d | Out-Null
$p=Join-Path $d 'ChromeStandaloneSetupARM64.exe'
& curl.exe --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 45 --output $p 'https://dl.google.com/chrome/install/ChromeStandaloneSetupARM64.exe'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Official Chrome download failed'}
$s=Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $p
@{source='https://dl.google.com/chrome/install/ChromeStandaloneSetupARM64.exe';bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $p).Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;signatureStatus=[string]$s.Status;publisher=$s.SignerCertificate.Subject;path=$p;executed=$false} | ConvertTo-Json
